name: cms
description: Core CMS analysis plugin: CMSSW releases and architectures, OS containers, EDM modules, cmsRun configuration, EDM file inspection, and the Scikit-HEP stack on NanoAOD (Awkward Array, vector, hist), NanoAOD skimming with luminosity and normalisation bookkeeping, analysis specifications, and CMS Combine: answering Combine questions from its docs, paper, code and forum, and running Combine commands (remote servers need the CERN network).
